test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The shares of students studying in different streams of a college in the years 2021 and 2022 are as reflected in the two pie charts given below. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19c31e4bb15fcbea1f3c4d9c6b5c9196f4d535327834e472407bd46a29910ebb.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

Let, Total no. of students in 2021 = x

Total no. of students in 2022 = y

So, number of pharmaceutical sciences in 2022 = 25.2y

Number of pharmaceutical sciences in 2021 = 32.4x

Number of students opting for agriculture in 2022 = 25.2y

Number of students opting for agriculture in 2021 = 21.6x

According to the question,

25.2y = 32.4x + 180 ---(1)

⇒ y = (32.4x + 180)/25.2 ---(2)

25.2y = 21.4x + 1380 ---(3)

Comparing equations (1) and (3), we get

32.4x + 180 = 21.6x + 1380

⇒ 32.4x - 21.6x = 1380 - 180

⇒ 10.8x = 1200

⇒ x = 1200/10.8 = 111.11° 

Putting the value of x in equation (2), we get

So, y = ((32.4 × 1200)/10.8 + 180)/25.2 = 150° 

Now, difference between no. of students in 2021 and 2022 = (150 - 111.11) × 360 

⇒ 13996.4 ≈ 14000

**∴ The positive difference between the total number of students in 2021 and 2022 was 14000.**
